# Sorgen.Co

> > Sorgen.Co is India's leading provider of medical-grade compression stockings, orthopedic support gear, and sports compression wear for pain relief, recovery, and circulation health.

Sorgen.Co specializes in compression therapy products including medical compression stockings for varicose veins and chronic venous insufficiency, sports compression socks for athletic performance, and orthopedic support gear for injury recovery and daily comfort. The brand offers multiple product lines (Royale, Classique, Premiere) across various compression classes and materials including cotton and copper-infused options.
